---
title: "Access"
---

There are three ways to reach the data. Use the first one that works for you.

| You are... | Use | Account needed |
|---|---|---|
| Working on the WHOI HPC cluster | Direct path under `{{< var vast_prefix >}}` | WHOI HPC account |
| On a WHOI computer (on site or VPN) | SMB share | WHOI login |
| Outside WHOI, or without VAST access | HTTPS download | None |
| Moving many terabytes off site | Globus (planned) | Globus account |

## HPC cluster

The store is mounted read-only at `{{< var vast_prefix >}}` on the cluster.
This is the fastest option and the one to use for large analyses: open files
in place with xarray, or through the [intake-esm catalog](catalog.qmd).

```python
import xarray as xr
ds = xr.open_mfdataset(
    "{{< var vast_prefix >}}/cmip6/CMIP/NCAR/CESM2/historical/r1i1p1f1/Amon/tas/gn/v20190308/*.nc"
)
```

## SMB share

From a WHOI laptop or desktop, connect to the share `{{< var smb_path >}}`
(placeholder until IT confirms the share name). The directory layout is the
same as on the cluster.

::: {.callout-tip}
Many people reading the same files over SMB at once has caused errors in the
past. For heavy or parallel reads, work on the cluster instead.
:::

## HTTPS download

Files can be downloaded over HTTPS, with no account, from
`{{< var https_prefix >}}` (placeholder until the download host is set up).
URLs follow the same layout as the store. There is no directory listing: use
the [browser](browse.qmd) to generate a list of file URLs, then follow the
[download guide](download-guide.qmd).

Downloads are rate limited to keep the service available to everyone. For
large transfers, use the cluster or ask about Globus.

## Globus (planned)

A Globus collection for bulk transfers is planned but not available yet.
